ports.note: Points in, a keyed table of periods out, so a Table output can display the series and a Chart output can draw it as a curve. The time axis needs no new port type: the dates are already attributes of the input.

ontology.note: fw:CaseSeries is declared disjoint from fw:PointDataset, and fw:CaseSeriesShape requires the kind of date and the period, so a series that does not say what it is a series of cannot conform. Verified in tests; this registry version records application validation only.

changes.description: Month of the year as a period: January to December, every year together, all twelve kept (the practitioner, 2026-11-12).

evidence.note: Unit checks cover weighted versus unweighted totals, retained empty periods, Monday-based weeks and month grouping, the required kind of date, refusal to parse a non-ISO date, and refusal of a non-numeric or negative weight. It counts what it is told to count: nothing here establishes that the declared weight really is a case count or that the dates are accurate. 0.3.0: tests/hagelloch-example.browser.mjs (seven bars Monday to Sunday, 23 21 25 34 30 27 28) and tests/epidemic-curve.browser.mjs through Configure…; Chromium. 0.4.0: tests/case-series.test.mjs (month of the year across two years with an empty month, a weight and an undated record; day of the week Monday to Sunday).
